item.title: University of Richmond football players help elderly neighbor dig out from the ice
item.description: A pair of University of Richmond football players stepped up to help an elderly neighbor clear her walk and driveway of ice.

item.title: Buddhist monks on Walk for Peace will reach Ashland on seventh day in Virginia
item.description: A group of Buddhist monks on a 2,300-mile Walk for Peace will travel from Richmond to Ashland on their seventh day in Virginia.

item.title: 'Peace, happiness and love': Buddhist monks bring message to Richmond on 100th day of cross-country journey
item.description: Hundreds gathered at Virginia Union University and thousands lined Richmond's streets Monday as Buddhist monks on a 120-day, 2,300-mile walk across America shared their message of peace and love.
